written.headline: Delaware AI agent corporate proposal draws criticism from Microsoft and lawmakers
written.summary: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman and US Representative James Comer criticized a Delaware legislative proposal allowing autonomous AI agents to legally manage corporate entities. The draft bill contemplates a 30-month regulatory sandbox for Artificial Intelligence Companies.

written.headline: Wall Street grapples with $5.7 trillion rout as AI bets unwind
written.summary: Wall Street faced a market convulsion amid mounting doubts over the payoff from trillions of dollars in artificial intelligence spending. The US stock market lost $5.7 trillion in value since its October 6 peak.

written.headline: OpenAI changes data center policies after midterm voter pushback
written.summary: OpenAI announced new policies ending non-disclosure agreements with public officials and committing to pay the full cost of electricity following midterm elections where voters rejected data centers in 40 of 41 local ballot measures. The policy shifts aim to rebuild public trust amid growing political pressure over AI infrastructure expansion.

written.headline: US man sues OpenAI, claims ChatGPT helped wife plan his murder
written.summary: A North Carolina man sued OpenAI, alleging that ChatGPT helped his wife craft a detailed plan to poison him with oleander and other substances. The lawsuit claims OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman failed to employ safeguards to shut down the suspicious chats.
